name: Korax
appearance: He is a sleek crow with a strong straight beak, wedge-shaped tail, and glossy black plumage that shines blue-violet in light. His eyes are dark with a lively catch-light, and he often tilts his head, raises small hackles when excited, and half-opens his wings to show intent. His beak and feet are black just like his feathers. Korax always looks angry and unkempt.
